consumer: The pickup path's weight-fit check that asks 'will adding this candidate item's weight exceed the avatar's weight capacity?', i.e. the engine's own can-pickWeight/weight_capacity-vs-item-weight computation.
scope: The candidate item's weight measured against the avatar's current weight capacity (current carried weight plus this one item), not whole-inventory or display state.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_avatar (scalars) — writes hp/stamina/moves/pain/thirst/fatigue/stored_kcal/kcal_percent from getters; it exposes no weight, weight_capacity, or fit predicate, so it cannot answer the weight-fit question.
divergence: An avatar near their weight cap about to pick up a heavy item: the engine's capacity predicate returns 'won't fit', but the scalar snapshot reports no weight or capacity figure, so any fit answer derived from these scalars is unfounded.
